definitions.short: Gilgal , the name of three places in Palestine
definitions.full: H1537. Gilgal II. גִּלְגָּל proper name, of a location (= (sacred) circle of stones; compare Di on Josh 5:9 , where word-play on roll away, off) — with article except 5:9 ; 12:23 ; — 1 place east of Jericho, where Israel lay encamped Josh 4:19-20 , 5:9-10 , 9:6 ; 10:7 , 9 ; 14:6 compare also Micah 6:5 & Judg 3:19 אֶתהַֿגּ ׳אֲשֶׁר הַמְּסִילִים ;? modern Tell Jeljul Bd Pal 169 ; perhaps also the place where sacrifices were offered 1Sam 10:8 ; 11:14-15 , (twice in verse); 13:4 , 7 , 8 , 12 , 15 (in 13:15 insert also with other words, Dr compare We) 15:12 , 21 , 33 ; place of illicit sacrifice Hosea 4:15 ; 9:15 ; 12:12 ; Amos 4:4 ; 5:5 (twice in verse), named also Judg 2:1 ; 1Sam 7:16 ; 2Sam 19:16 ; 19:41 ; ? = הַגִּלְגָּל בֵּית Neh 12:29 . 2 place on border between Judah & Benjamin Josh 15:17 (= גְּלִילוֺת 18:17 compare Di). 3 place in Northern Israel, dwelling of prophets 2Kin 2:1 ; 4:38 , modern Jiljilie south from Nâbulus, southwest from Seilûn (Shiloh) compare Di Ri HWB 518. 4 place in Northern Israel near Mt. Gerizim and Mt.
